notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
